items.exampleEn: There was no mention of the price on the website.
items.exampleZh: 網站上完全沒有提到價格。

items.exampleEn: Our teacher started a discussion about the news.
items.exampleZh: 老師帶大家開始討論這則新聞。

items.exampleEn: The notice says the pool is closed on Monday.
items.exampleZh: 公告上說游泳池星期一不開放。

items.exampleEn: The new road started a debate in our town.
items.exampleZh: 這條新道路在我們鎮上引起了爭論。

items.exampleEn: The two drivers had an argument after the accident.
items.exampleZh: 兩位駕駛在事故之後吵了一架。

items.exampleEn: Email is a fast form of communication.
items.exampleZh: 電子郵件是一種快速的溝通方式。

items.exampleEn: Don't sit too close to the TV screen.
items.exampleZh: 不要坐得離電視螢幕太近。
媽媽每天早上都傳簡訊給我。

items.sentenceEn: Please read the notice on the wall.

items.audioEn: The debate starts at two in the school hall.
items.audioZh: 辯論會兩點在學校禮堂開始。

items.sentenceEn: I sent you a text an hour ago.
items.sentenceZh: 我一個小時前傳了簡訊給你。

items.sentenceEn: This computer screen is too small for me.
items.sentenceZh: 這個電腦螢幕對我來說太小了。

items.stemEn: After a long ____, we finally agreed on a plan.
items.stemZh: 經過一番長時間的討論，我們終於對計畫達成共識。

items.stemEn: They had a big ____ about money and stopped talking.
items.stemZh: 他們為了錢大吵一架，之後就不說話了。

items.passageEn: Last semester, our school had a big debate about phones in class. Before the debate, the student committee put a notice on the board. Some students said phones make communication with parents easier. Others said students look at their screens too much and read texts in class. After the debate, there was a long discussion, but nobody made any mention of the teachers' phones!
items.passageZh: 上學期，我們學校針對上課用手機舉辦了一場大型辯論。辯論前，學生委員會在公告欄貼了公告。有些同學說手機讓和家長的溝通更容易；也有人說學生太常盯著螢幕，上課還在看簡訊。辯論結束後大家討論了很久，可是沒有一個人提到老師們的手機！

questions.questionZh: 辯論前，學生委員會做了什麼？
討論中沒有人提到什麼？

referenceEn: The communication between us is very good.
rubricZh: 可寫例如 the communication between us、have good communication

items.instructionZh: 用 argument 造一個句子，說說你和別人的一次爭執，或你怎麼避免吵架。
referenceEn: I had an argument with my friend last week.
We try not to have arguments at dinner.
rubricZh: argument 是可數名詞（例如 an argument、arguments）
可寫例如 have an argument with＋人

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似不自然："phones help communication with parents"，較道地為 "phones help them communicate with parents" 或 "help students keep in touch with parents"。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "Last semester, our school had a big debate about phones in class. Before the debate, the student committee put a notice on the board. Some students said phones make communication with parents easier. Others said students look at their screens too much and read texts in class. After the debate, there was a long discussion, but nobody made any mention of the teachers' phones!"（原 "Last semester, our school had a big debate about phones in class. Before the debate, the student committee put a notice on the board. Some students said phones help communication with parents. Others said students look at their screens too much and read texts in class. After the debate, there was a long discussion, but nobody made any mention of the teachers' phones!"）；communication 是本課字，保留名詞用法

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：中譯配合英文修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "上學期，我們學校針對上課用手機舉辦了一場大型辯論。辯論前，學生委員會在公告欄貼了公告。有些同學說手機讓和家長的溝通更容易；也有人說學生太常盯著螢幕，上課還在看簡訊。辯論結束後大家討論了很久，可是沒有一個人提到老師們的手機！"（原 "上學期，我們學校針對上課用手機舉辦了一場大型辯論。辯論前，學生委員會在公告欄貼了公告。有些同學說手機有助於和家長溝通；也有人說學生太常盯著螢幕，上課還在看簡訊。辯論結束後大家討論了很久，可是沒有一個人提到老師們的手機！"）
